table.retrieve:
SELECT
	quotationcode = dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode,
	date = dbo.quotationheader.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.quotationheader.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.quotationheader.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.quotationheader.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.quotationheader.salestax,
	invgstperc1 = dbo.quotationheader.invgstperc1,
	CustRefNo   = dbo.quotationheader.remarks,
	Patient     = dbo.quotationheader.Remarks,
	posted = dbo.quotationheader.posted,	
	looseqty = dbo.quotationdetail.qty, 
	packing=case
				when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) 
				else dbo.itempacking.name
			end,
	itemflatdisc=quotationdetail.itemflatdisc,
	
	price = dbo.quotationdetail.saleprice,    
	itemdiscperc = dbo.quotationdetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.quotationdetail.packunits,    
	
	salestax  = quotationdetail.salestax,
	itemname = item.name,
	unitsalestax = dbo.quotationdetail.unitsalestax ,    
	gstperc = dbo.quotationdetail.gstperc ,    
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, quotationheader.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, quotationheader.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, quotationheader.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	/* 
	invnettotalexctax= (SELECT 
				  amountfg = Round( 
										 Sum (  SD.qty *  SD.saleprice)    
										 -  Round(Sum (Round((  SD.qty  * ( SD.saleprice -  SD.itemflatdisc) * ( SD.discperc * .01)) + ( SD.qty  *  SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)    
										 - Sum ( Round( SD.qty   * ( SD.saleprice  -  SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * ( SL.discperc /100)
										 + misccharges - flatdisc,0)
	
		 FROM dbo.quotationheader SL , 
				dbo.quotationdetail SD
	
		 WHERE  (SL.quotationcode = dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode )   and
				  (SL.quotationcode = SD.quotationcode )   
	
		 GROUP BY SL.misccharges,   
					 SL.flatdisc,   
					 SL.date,   
					 SL.quotationcode, 
					 SL.invgstperc1, 
					 SL.discperc,  
					 SL.salestax 
	) , */
	totalsalestax = (SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
								 Round (
	/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SD.qty * ( SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
										 * ( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
	/*items salestax*/		 + Sum (Round (SD.qty * SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SD.qty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )						 
								 , 0 )
		 FROM dbo.quotationheader SL , 
				dbo.quotationdetail SD
	
		 WHERE  (SL.quotationcode = dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode )   and
				  (SL.quotationcode = SD.quotationcode )   
	
		 GROUP BY SL.misccharges,   
					 SL.flatdisc,   
					 SL.date,   
					 SL.quotationcode, 
					 SL.invgstperc1, 
					 SL.discperc,  
					 SL.salestax 
	)
	
FROM 	 
	dbo.quotationheader, 
	dbo.quotationdetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  
	dbo.quotationheader.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.quotationheader.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = dbo.quotationdetail.quotationcode and  
	dbo.quotationdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.quotationheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: /* Round(sum(   c_amount  for all ) + sum(misccharges for all distinct   saleinvcode ) - sum( flatdisc  for all distinct saleinvcode) -   compute_4 , 0) */

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum((((  looseqty   *  price  ) - (itemflatdisc* looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ))  *  invdiscperc  * 0.01 for all)

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  quotationcode  )  +  compute_4

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum( misccharges for all Distinct   quotationcode  )

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: sum( totalsalestax for all Distinct quotationcode  )

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: Round ( Sum( c_amount for all) + sum ( misccharges for all distinct  quotationcode ) -  sum ( flatdisc  for all distinct quotationcode ) - Sum(  Round ( ( ( looseqty   *  price  ) - ( itemflatdisc *  looseqty) )    *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) * (   invdiscperc  * 0.01 )   , 2)   for all ) , 0)  + Round ( Sum ( totalsalestax  for all distinct quotationcode ) , 0 )

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(((  looseqty   *  price  )-(itemflatdisc* looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ), 2)

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( (  looseqty *  unitsalestax ) + Round ( c_amount *  gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) ,  2 )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round (Sum(((  looseqty   *  price  )-( itemflatdisc * looseqty ))  *  ( 1 - (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 2) *  ( 1 - invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)  +  Round ( totalsalestax, 0 )

objects.name: c_invsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( Round ( ( Sum( ( ( looseqty   *  price  )  -  ( looseqty   *  itemflatdisc  ) ) *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  - flatdisc  ) , 2 ) * ( invgstperc1 * 0.01 ),  2)
